communications.title: Submission of Annual Property Statement 2025-26 on HRMS Portal
communications.content:
In accordance with Rule 21 of the Odisha Government Servants' Conduct Rules, 1959, all Group A, Group B, and Group C State Government employees are hereby instructed to file and submit their Annual Property Statement for the Financial Year 2025-26 online through the e-PAR & Property module of the HRMS Odisha Portal on or before the revised deadline of 31st March 2026.

Please note:
1. All movable and immovable properties held by the government servant or acquired in the name of any family member must be declared accurately.
2. Non-compliance or delayed submission shall result in withholding of annual increments and vigilance clearance for promotions and transfers.
3. DDOs and Establishment Officers are directed to verify and countersign employee submissions without delay.
communications.summary: Instruction for online filing of Annual Property Statement 2025-26 on HRMS before 31-Mar-2026.
communications.senderOffice: Odisha Secretariat, Lok Seva Bhawan, Bhubaneswar

communications.title: Verification and Re-fixation of Pay & DA Arrears under 7th CPC Revised Pay Rules
communications.content:
It is hereby notified to all establishment staff that the verification of revised Dearness Allowance (DA) rates and annual increment fixation records for the current financial year has been completed and countersigned by the Drawing & Disbursing Officer (DDO).

Employees are advised to inspect their updated monthly payslips and digital e-Service Book fixation entries on the portal. Any discrepancies in basic pay, grade pay, or DA calculations must be reported to the DDO Accounts Wing via the Grievance/Help Desk module within 15 working days.
communications.summary: DA revision and 7th CPC annual increment verification completed by Establishment Accounts Section.
communications.senderOffice: Panchayati Raj & Drinking Water Department, Government of Odisha, Bhubaneswar

communications.title: Mandatory e-KYC Verification and Aadhaar Seeding in HRMS Profile
communications.content:
As per the directions of the Centre for Modernizing Government Initiative (CMGI) and General Administration & Public Grievance Department, all State Government employees must verify and validate their personal demographic information, mobile numbers, Aadhaar details, emergency contacts, and family nominee declarations in their HRMS profile.

Failure to complete e-KYC verification may cause temporary interruption in e-Service Book generation, online leave processing, and digital LPC issuance during transfer and joining.
communications.summary: Mandatory biometric/OTP e-KYC profile update and nominee declaration for all state employees.
communications.senderOffice: Odisha Secretariat, Lok Seva Bhawan, Bhubaneswar

communications.title: Empanelment of Specialized Hospitals under Odisha State Employee Health Scheme (OSEHS)
communications.content:
Health & Family Welfare Department has notified the empanelment of 14 additional super-specialty hospitals and diagnostic centers across Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Rourkela, Sambalpur, and Berhampur for cashless in-patient treatment and specialized surgeries for State Government employees and their dependent family members.

Eligible beneficiaries can avail cashless admissions by presenting their HRMS Employee ID Card and Health Scheme Enrollment Certificate at hospital TPA help desks.
communications.summary: Notification of 14 newly empanelled super-specialty hospitals for cashless medical benefits.
communications.senderOffice: Government of Odisha, Lok Seva Bhawan
